answer.verdict: Claude should keep the live loop (instrument, one game run, commit, user text). Grok should keep static RE, patch review, and scoped fixes. Claude's review of Grok is right on W1, W2, and A1-A7; three of its numbers (S3 order, W3 $0.07, W4 >70 min) do not match the surviving logs. The stall is still the VIF1 MFIFO ring, and patch 12 did not move it.

facts.c: Session result that stands: native VU1 fight is 11-25 fps vs interpreter 7-9; stall at ~4 s is not native VU1; cause traced to VIF1 MFIFO (TADR 0x13d350 NEXT qwc=0x3000, write pos already 0x13d490) and not fixed. Patch 12 carry+CHCR, tests 466/466, neither half fixes the stall.

Claude's method is hypothesis then one new trace field then a fight run. After speed was in, captured runs include vu1n_fight3 117.1s, fight4 115.1s, vu1_interp_long 181.0s, fight5-8 110.2s, fight9 110.6s, vif1_carry_fight1 151.5s, carry_fight3 110.2s, carry_fight5 110.1s, mfifo_wait_fight1 171.8s. Early menu runs are 6-25s. A header rebuild was ~3.5 min.

Not-native finding took two comparison runs (vu1n_fight4 checklong + interpreter-only 181s). STMOD-to-carry took fight6-9 (4 runs) and the stall remained (vif1_carry_fight1 still vif1-bad:3). Drain-wait was pinned on mfifo_wait_fight1-5; fight2-5 durations are trimmed out of the digest.
User-visible correction is good: 5191 says the CHCR rule did not fire and the stall remains; 5242 corrects tests 467 to 466 before commit c53d894. Push of the generator was refused and not bypassed.

Premature cause: push text said the stall cause was a fake STMOD 2 while the next runs still stalled. Reasoning then replaced that with REF-as-data, then a CHCR restart, then the drain wait. The notification was not delivered.

Commits are one concern each across the milestone list (patch 09 18431ca, vf0 fda9e02, patch 12 c53d894, Grok write mode 9fd88bb, auto+deny e20d920). User 'keep working' overrode one-goal-per-session; that is not scope drift.

User replies name the number that changed (fps, which fix fired, what is left). Longest detour while five Grok tasks and a fight were in flight was the phone/remote-control answer, and the user had asked 'claude rc'.

Grok permission path was four stages: plan mode, allow-lists (Execute( prefix rejected), --always-approve blocked by Claude auto mode, auto+deny (first deny rule broke on the ISO name), then --json-schema. Three early answers died on a refused tool: vu1-stall python, vu1-vi12 Write logs/grok, pad2-fix fetch and Get-ChildItem. Prompt-file fixed PS 5.1 quote mangling after a 0s failure.

fix.change: C1. Do not say 'cause found' to the user or in a notification until a later run shows the named symptom gone (no vif1-bad, no 0x32a0 budget, fps held past 4 s). Tie: digest 4857 vs 4930 and 5191.

C2. One fight iteration changes one log field. Write the predicted line before the run. Stop the series when the new field repeats. Tie: fight6-9 plus mfifo_wait_fight1-5, each 110-172 s plus a rebuild.

C3. A fix that does not fire on the stall trace is not described as the stall fix. Commit it only with a unit test and a status line that the symptom did not move. Tie: CHCR rule, digest 5191, still inside c53d894; status 584 already says neither half fixes the stall.

C4. Every Grok prompt is TASK CTX FACTS ASK LIMITS DOD. FACTS paste the decisive log lines verbatim (addresses and counters). The hypothesis is labeled hypothesis. No word cap. Tie: mfifo prompt omits write pos 0x13d490 and swaps E040/E050.
C5. Freeze permissions at auto+deny (e20d920). One probe, then no relaunch of a live task onto a new mode. Tie: digest 4340-4735 and the mscal kill at 4782.
C6. Do not start out\runtime build while a Grok-owned file is dirty. Wait for that task's JSON or copy the owned file aside. Tie: status 607-608 and digest 5237.

C7. If the work-task notes file is newer than the last run dir and names the required shots, stop that grok.exe. Do not wait for a second writeup. Tie: notes 21:04:18 vs process still alive at digest 5258.

C8. On 'what's left' or 'progress', answer only done / running / next and the one number that changed. Keep the longer writeup for the commit and status.md. Tie: 5096 and 5191 are the model; unsolicited cause claims are not.
G1. If FACTS do not contain the log numbers the fix must match, do not propose the fix. Put the missing lines in open[] and set conf<=0.5. A1 is not satisfied by reading status later. Tie: W1.
G2. One mechanism sentence. If a second mechanism fits the same bytes, it goes in open[], not in the best-fit line. Tie: W2 bit-15 vs STMOD 2.
G3. Work mode: when the prompt DOD is met (notes + named runs + JSON), stop. No extra run and no extra reading. Tie: brief A4 and the pad2 overrun.
W1. Ask mode denies powershell run_capture.ps1, pcsx2_capture.ps1, and python tools/pine.py. Work mode is the only mode that may hold the run lock.
W2. Stopping the wrapper kills the child grok.exe. Digest 4784 shows TaskStop leaves the child.
W3. files_changed is only the git delta under -Owns plus logs/grok. Do not list unrelated dirty files (Pad.cpp on an ask task, status.md on probe-build).
W4. Keep --json-schema. Add required contradictions[] when fix is non-empty. Persist cost_usd from the CLI meta in the result json. Drop the prose word cap from prompts; the schema is the cap.
W5. Work mode writes logs/grok/run.lock and refuses to start if the lock exists. Claude's run scripts take the same lock.

P1. Claude owns instrumentation, the one game or PCSX2 run, patches, the test suite, commits, status.md, and all user text. Reason: the stall moved only when Claude added a trace field and ran (digest 4808-5148); commits are Claude's (CLAUDE.md, grok_task.ps1:18).

P2. Grok owns ELF and generated-C static RE, PCSX2 source quotes, upstream patch review, a second opinion on a trace already on disk, and a scoped Owns fix with a fixed run script. Reason: sound-iop.md, vif-mode section 2, patch09 must-fixes, and pad2-fix-notes.md; mscal's best-fit failed because it was a live-mechanism guess.

P3. Do not give both AIs the same open mechanism. Grok gets the trace after Claude has one stable log, or Grok gets a review of a patch before an upstream PR. mfifo-switch ran in parallel with the hunt and its fix contradicted the log (digest 5178).

P4. Claude->Grok handoff is the six blocks in C4. Grok->Claude handoff is the JSON object only. Claude reads facts with v=true and open[] before editing. Narrative in the md is scratch, not the handoff.

P5. Verification: Claude checks every Grok fix against the pasted log numbers and does not apply a contradicted fix (digest 5178 is the model). For Grok code, Claude reads the diff, the named screenshot or stdout, and the tests, then commits. For a Claude patch aimed upstream, Grok reviews the patch file first (patch09).

P6. One of run_capture, pcsx2_capture, or pine at a time. Builds may overlap only as out\runtime vs out\grok, and only when no owned source file is dirty. Ask tasks have no run lock. Cap in-flight Grok at 1 work + 2 ask during a fight run so the 110-180s capture is not competing with four high-effort reads.

P7. Disagreement: contradicted fix is dropped. Next step is the single PCSX2 observation already in status (ring 0x13d300-0x13d4a0 at the fight point), done by whoever holds the run lock. If both still disagree after that dump, ask the user. No third mechanism paper from either side before that dump.

P8. Only Claude writes docs/status.md and commits. An adopted Grok fact cites the json path. A commit whose diff is Grok's names that log in the body. Grok never commits or pushes. Upstream PR text stays 'Made by Pablo and assisted with Claude Code' (status Publishing).
